description.value: The Abbotsford Arts Centre is a 700+ seat performing arts facility operated by the Abbotsford School District, equipped with full concert lighting, sound, and fly systems capable of supporting major productions. It hosts a diverse year-round calendar of theatre, dance, and cultural events serving local schools, touring productions, community groups, and the general public. The adjacent 3,150 sq. ft. Community Arts Addition seats an additional 260 and is available for banquets, receptions, and rehearsals.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the Abbotsford Arts Centre is an active 700+ seat performing arts venue operated by the Abbotsford School District, with upcoming public events listed. Phone (604.853.0966) and address (2329 Crescent Way, Abbotsford BC V2S 3M1) both match OSM tags exactly. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, showers, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all amenity fields are null.
concerns: OSM record contains two different URL fields: 'url' (http://www.abbotsfordartscentre.ca/) and 'website' (https://abbotsfordarts.abbyschools.ca). The abbyschools.ca domain is the current active site; the legacy URL was not verified.
Venue is operated by the Abbotsford School District; general public access is event-dependent rather than drop-in.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The venue is a legitimate public cultural attraction with an active event calendar, but it is school-district-operated with access primarily tied to scheduled performances rather than walk-in visits; no cycling amenities are confirmed, making its value to a touring cyclist limited to attending ticketed events.

wow_evidence: 700-seat performing arts facility with year-round public calendar — show-conditional delight; wins over its duplicate theatre node.
blurb: 700-seat Abbotsford performance venue; theatre, dance, and concerts.

price.label: Moderate
price.signal: 700-seat performing arts venue; event tickets typically $20-45
